validationPolicy.onTooShort: ask ONE follow-up that shows the example; accept whatever the owner sends next (never refuse twice)
alwaysBlockOn: empty answer on a required question
a choice that is not in the list and is not 'Other: ...'
a color that cannot be resolved
a logo link that is not http or https

questions.prompt: What name should we put on everything we build for you?
questions.help: Use the name your customers know you by. You can change it later.

questions.prompt: What kind of business is it?
questions.help: A few words is perfect. This decides which teams we recommend.

questions.prompt: In a sentence or two, what do you sell?
questions.help: Say it the way you would to a friend. If you have not started selling yet, tell us what you plan to sell.
questions.example: A 12-week coaching program and a monthly group call.

questions.prompt: Where is the business today?
questions.help: Pick the closest one.

questions.prompt: Who is your best kind of customer?
questions.help: Describe one real person or company you love working with.
questions.example: Women who just became managers at mid-size companies and feel in over their heads.
legacyPrompts: Who is your ideal customer — and why do they come to YOU specifically?

questions.prompt: Why do customers pick you instead of someone else?
questions.help: The honest reason, not the slogan.
questions.example: I answer my own phone and I have done their exact job for ten years.
legacyPrompts: Why do people come to YOU versus anyone else who does what you do?

questions.prompt: After working with you, how should a customer feel?
questions.help: Tap one or write your own.
questions.example: Relieved, like a weight is off their shoulders.
legacyPrompts: What feeling do you want your customers to leave with after working with you?

questions.prompt: Give me three words a happy customer would use to describe you.
questions.help: Three words is enough.
legacyPrompts: What words would your best customer use to describe you?

questions.prompt: When someone sees your brand for the first time, what should they feel in the first five seconds?
questions.help: Optional. Skip it and we will use your answer about how customers feel.
legacyPrompts: What feeling do you want your brand to evoke?

questions.prompt: How should your company sound when it writes or talks?
questions.help: Optional. Pick the closest one.
legacyPrompts: How would you describe your brand voice?

questions.prompt: What is your main brand color?
questions.help: Optional. Type a color name like navy or a code like #1E3A8A.
legacyPrompts: What is your primary brand color?

questions.prompt: Do you have a logo? Add it here.
questions.help: Optional. Upload a picture or paste a link.
legacyPrompts: Do you have a logo? Paste a public link to it (or upload one).

questions.prompt: What would make the next 12 months a win, in sales?
questions.help: A rough range is fine. We use it to set targets for your team.

questions.prompt: What matters most in the next 90 days?
questions.help: Pick one. We build that team strongest first.

questions.prompt: What part of the business eats your time or do you dread doing?
questions.help: This is the first thing we take off your plate.
questions.example: Chasing unpaid invoices and answering the same five emails.

questions.prompt: Which tools do you use to run the business?
questions.help: Tap everything you use, then add anything missing. None yet is a fine answer.

questions.prompt: Where do customers find you today?
questions.help: Tap all that apply.

questions.prompt: Here is your team. Keep it all, or remove what you do not need.
questions.help: Everything is kept unless you remove it. You can add a team that is missing.
questions.completeWhen: the owner pressed Keep all, or changed at least one card, and no removal is waiting for its warning to be confirmed

questions.prompt: What is the first thing your {team} team should work on?
questions.help: One sentence. If you are not sure, tap I am not sure and we will suggest three options.
questions.example: Get me 20 new leads a month from Instagram.

questions.prompt: Is there one thing you do a special way that your team must follow?
questions.help: Optional. For example how you handle refunds or how you welcome a new customer.

questions.prompt: Anything else we should know before we build?
questions.help: Optional.

questions.prompt: What do you want to call your dashboard?
questions.help: Optional. Many owners pick something like Mission Control. Skip it and we will call it Command Center.
legacyPrompts: What would you like to name your company's home base?

optionalDeepDivePack.offeredAs: Help your team sound like you (5 more minutes)
optionalDeepDivePack.rules: Never part of completion. Every question can be skipped. Answers are written to company-discovery/owner-style-pack.jsonl and never to build-state (a write to interviewProgress after completion un-verifies a finished build).

questions.prompt: How would you describe your business to a friend at a cookout?
What part of the work do you love and want to keep doing yourself?
Is there something you used to enjoy that you no longer have time for?
Five years from now, what do you want this business to give you?
When a customer is upset, how do you like it handled?
If you had an extra $10,000 to grow this month, where would it go first?
Whose advice or style do you admire in business?
What is the most frustrating thing about running the business right now?
Is there a mistake you never want your team to repeat?
What do customers ask you about most?
Does your business have to follow any special rules or licenses?
How hands-on do you want to be with the technical side?
